mainText: Afghanistan released American national Dennis Coyle after more than one year of detention.
Voters in Denmark are voting as Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen seeks a third term.
Israel stated it will take control of a buffer zone in southern Lebanon.
The Trump administration plans to pay a French company $1 billion to relinquish U.S. offshore wind leases.
The World Meteorological Organization stated that ocean warming is at record levels and will continue for hundreds to thousands of years.
